9router.description:
9Router acts as a unified API endpoint for routing requests to different AI providers.

It is deployed to centralize access to models from Gemini API, Antigravity, Kiro, and other compatible services.
9router.overview:
9Router runs as the local API gateway for AI interactions within the home lab.

It is used to simplify client configurations by providing a single endpoint, allowing for rapid model switching and token optimization without altering frontend applications.

adguard-home.description:
AdGuard Home acts as the primary DNS server for the home lab, managing local DNS records and filtering traffic.

It is deployed to handle local domain resolution and block advertisements across the network.
adguard-home.overview:
AdGuard Home intercepts DNS queries to enforce custom filtering policies at the network level.

It is responsible for maintaining local DNS records used for accessing self-hosted services via standard domain names instead of IP addresses.

agent-dvr.description:
Agent DVR is used to manage video surveillance and IP camera recording for the local environment.

It is deployed to process video streams locally, keeping physical security data on the internal network.
agent-dvr.overview:
Agent DVR runs locally to aggregate multiple IP camera feeds into a single monitoring interface.

It is responsible for handling motion detection, storage retention policies, and alert generation completely offline.

It acts as a simple dashboard for assessing CPU, memory, and disk usage across the infrastructure.

It is used for quick identification of resource-heavy applications to ensure host systems operate within capacity.

docker.description:
Docker is used to run selected self-hosted services and isolated dependencies throughout the Home Lab.

It is deployed to isolate targeted applications and manage configuration consistency for containerized workloads.

It acts as the primary runtime where containerization simplifies application deployment, updates, service isolation, and maintenance.

It provides a controlled environment for testing routing behavior, switching designs, firewall policies, and migration scenarios before production implementation.

EVE-NG serves as a virtual engineering lab for reproducing production network environments and validating infrastructure changes.

It enables safe experimentation with multi-vendor network designs while reducing operational risk during deployment planning.
